description: This file is a Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for Customer entities in a Java Spring application. It contains methods for retrieving Customer objects by various criteria such as ID, name, nickname, and store, using JPA queries with QueryDSL integration.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Customer entity, providing methods to retrieve customers based on various criteria using QueryDSL and JPA.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its unique ID, including related entities via fetch joins.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customer entities matching the provided name, either in first or last name fields.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of Customers associated with a specific store, filtered by criteria such as name, email, and country.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Fetches a Customer by its nickname, optionally within a specified store ID; returns null if not found.
